extraction.Name: Virginia Miller Peniska
extraction.Refused/Protested: No I did not know what to do about it.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Mortgaged — Yes twice; mortgage still on land for $3000.00, due in December 1930
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: When I mortgaged the place I needed the money for doctors bills and I used some of the money in improving the place by erecting buildings and so forth. We are trying to pay off the mortgage but on account of short crops it is pretty hard to make much of an impression on it.
extraction.Occupation/Income: By myself and husband at farming.
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered at the Bank of Herrick on March 29, 1918. Did not ask for patent. All taxes paid except 1928 taxes. Still has the land. Has eight children. Did not remember signing a receipt for the patent. Subscribed and sworn before Notary Public Cas. W.
